stories.title: Iran vows to counter US naval blockade as Yemen strikes escalate
stories.summary: Iran's foreign ministry said Monday it will use "all available means" against the US naval blockade of its ports, calling it military aggression under the UN Charter. The same day, Houthi officials said a Saudi-led coalition strike on a telecom compound in the port city of Hodeida killed 17 workers, as fighting in Yemen intensifies.

stories.title: Australian music legend Molly Meldrum dies aged 83
stories.summary: Ian "Molly" Meldrum, the broadcaster and promoter who helped define Australian pop taste for decades through the TV show Countdown, has died at 83. Tributes came from across the Australian music industry, which credited him with breaking both local and international acts.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge partly collapses after Ukrainian attack
stories.summary: Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea with missiles and drones in an operation it says took weeks to plan, partly collapsing the span. Zelensky hailed the attack as "unprecedented" and said the logistics route used for Russian military supplies is now compromised.

stories.title: Jensen Huang called to testify before Senate Banking on December 3
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is scheduled to appear before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, hours after the board reinstated him, over export controls and his ties to a woman the US suspects of being a Chinese spy. He had already agreed to testify before three House committees on December 1.

stories.title: Amazon pays $7.5B for Decart's AI optimization tech
stories.summary: Amazon agreed to buy Israeli startup Decart's optimization software and much of its staff for $7.5 billion, according to Bloomberg. The technology helps AI models run efficiently on non-Nvidia hardware, which Amazon needs as it prepares to sell its own Trainium chips to outside customers.

stories.title: Trump endorses Huang's return to Nvidia, says no evidence of wrongdoing
stories.summary: President Trump said the US government sees no national security risk in Jensen Huang returning as Nvidia's CEO and claimed the attorney general found no evidence of unlawful conduct. His statement is unusual because the Justice Department normally conducts such reviews independently.

stories.title: Nvidia reverses course and reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO less than two weeks after he resigned over extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The board said it was satisfied with his candor after consulting senior US government officials; Colette Kress returns to CFO only.

stories.title: Denzel Ward credits Todd Monken's practice style for Browns' 6-4 start
stories.summary: Browns cornerback Denzel Ward said first-year coach Todd Monken's repetition-heavy practices are a big reason Cleveland is 6-4 and sitting sixth in the AFC playoff standings. Ward, allowing just 3.8 yards per target this season, is a leading All-Pro candidate on a defense carrying the team.

stories.title: Browns say they're 'under construction' but ahead of schedule at 6-4
stories.summary: Todd Monken said the rebuild is far from finished even though Cleveland, after trading Myles Garrett, has already topped last season's win total and is 4-0 at home for the first time since 1963. The bye week is being used to fix a run defense Delpit called a liability before a flexed Sunday night game with the Raiders.

stories.title: Browns climb AFC North during bye as Steelers and Ravens lose
stories.summary: Without playing, Cleveland moved into second place in the AFC North after Pittsburgh lost to Philadelphia and Baltimore fell to Carolina, putting the Ravens 2.5 games back. A Washington win over Cincinnati on Monday night would leave the Browns one game out of the division lead with both Bengals games still to play.

stories.title: Michigan plans to start Bryce Underwood, but injury clouds The Game
stories.summary: Kyle Whittingham said Monday that Bryce Underwood remains Michigan's starter for Saturday's game at Ohio State, but reports hours later said the quarterback has a lower-body injury that could sideline him. Tommy Carr, who started four games this season, would play instead.

stories.title: Whittingham embraces Ohio State rivalry in first trip to the Horseshoe
stories.summary: Michigan's first-year coach said he fully appreciates the magnitude of the rivalry ahead of his first game in Columbus, where the Wolverines are chasing a third straight win. Both teams arrive limping: Ohio State is 7-4 after losing at Nebraska, Michigan is 6-5 and dealing with injuries at quarterback, running back and tackle.

stories.title: Buckeyes handed injury news at running back before Michigan
stories.summary: Ohio State heads into the Michigan game without running back Ja'Kobi Jackson, who has been out since Lisfranc surgery and had hoped to return late in the regular season. The Buckeyes are also working around the loss of starting quarterback Julian Sayin, leaving freshman Luke Fahey to start The Game.

stories.title: Meyer and Tressel back Ryan Day to have Ohio State ready for Michigan
stories.summary: Urban Meyer and Jim Tressel said they believe Ryan Day will have the Buckeyes prepared for The Game despite a 7-4 season that ended their Big Ten and playoff hopes at Nebraska. Day is 2-4 against Michigan, and beating the Wolverines is the only goal left this year.

stories.title: F1 presses on with Qatar and Abu Dhabi races amid regional tensions
stories.summary: Formula 1 is keeping its Middle East finale despite escalating US-Iran tensions, after an Italian replacement race failed to materialise and Bahrain and Saudi Arabia were already moved or cancelled this season. Teams say staff retain the right to refuse to travel, with Cadillac's CEO calling safety "absolutely paramount".

stories.title: Qatar preview: Verstappen chases fifth win as title fight winds down
stories.summary: F1 heads to Lusail for the penultimate round with Kimi Antonelli already crowned champion and Mercedes holding the constructors' title. Max Verstappen, winner in Las Vegas, is targeting another victory while the Verstappen-Russell feud and Ferrari's Hamilton-Leclerc clashes carry over into the weekend.

stories.title: Nine points for third: Red Bull and McLaren set for constructors' fight
stories.summary: Red Bull leads McLaren by just nine points for third in the constructors' championship with two rounds left, after McLaren outscored them 33-25 in Las Vegas. Verstappen also needs to leave Qatar more than 25 points clear of Lewis Hamilton to lock up second in the drivers' standings.

stories.title: Two COTA drivers killed in head-on bus crash near fairgrounds
stories.summary: Two Central Ohio Transit Authority drivers died and at least nine other people were hurt when two buses collided head-on on East 11th Avenue near the Ohio Expo Center, with a third vehicle then hitting one bus. Columbus police are reviewing Ring and onboard camera footage; a westbound bus is believed to have crossed the center line.

stories.title: One COTA driver died at the scene, the other at a hospital
stories.summary: Columbus fire officials said one bus driver was pronounced dead at East 11th and North 6th and the second died after transport, with the injured listed as stable. Four of the hurt were in an SUV, the rest were aboard a bus, and COTA and police were expected to release statements later Monday.

stories.title: Medics called to three-vehicle crash involving two city buses
stories.summary: Dispatchers sent medics to East 11th Avenue and North 6th Street at 8:02 a.m. after a crash involving two COTA buses and a third vehicle. Two people died and 12 were initially taken to hospitals, making it one of the deadliest transit crashes in Columbus in years.

stories.title: Cooler but sunny Monday across central Ohio
stories.summary: Columbus turned mostly sunny and much cooler Monday with a high near 49 and northwest winds gusting to 20 mph. The dry, chilly stretch sets up a cold Thanksgiving travel week around central Ohio.
